item.title: Version 2.0.5
item.description:
Live Activities, more useful message actions and Home tools, plus a quieter, more reliable Notchy.

  • Live Activities — timers, downloads and other ongoing updates share the notch more naturally, with an iPhone-inspired look
  • Messages and notifications — open or reply to Teams messages from Notchy, and keep notification banners out of the way
  • Feedback and quick actions — browse feedback and wish-list ideas, use new Dock menu actions, and show symbols with App Intents
  • Minor fixes and refinements — lower idle activity, clearer battery warnings, steadier lock-screen behavior on Ventura, and updates to Terminal, capture tools and glass

All release notes

item.title: Version 2.0.4
item.description:
Copy verification codes from the notch, answer Claude Code without leaving what you’re doing, pin screenshots to your screen and convert audio and video on the shelf, plus a tidier pill on Macs without a notch.

  • Notifications and agents — copy a verification code in one click, answer Claude Code’s questions from the notch, and watch a ring fill while your meeting runs
  • Screenshots and files — pin a capture to your screen, click a window to capture it, add numbered steps, a loupe and curved arrows, and convert audio and video on the shelf
  • Clipboard and keyboard — link previews, character counts, history brought over from Maccy or Alfred, Caps Lock as a Hyper key, and windows you move with modifier keys
  • Minor fixes and refinements — a Lyrics card for Home, hide Notchy in apps you choose, a break reminder of your own, a full player in the menu bar, Xcode build islands, clearer glass on bright wallpapers and a Dock menu

All release notes

item.title: Version 2.0.3
item.description:
A floating music player, lyrics that light up word by word, animated album art and a livelier notch, plus Window Watch, an Action Ring and a shelf you can open anywhere.

  • Music — a floating player in four sizes, swipe the cover to skip a song, lyrics that light up word by word, and animated album art from Apple Music
  • A livelier notch — activities split and merge like liquid, the panel opens and closes in two smooth beats, and motion is tuned to each display
  • New tools — shake a dragged file to open a shelf right where you are, watch part of any window and get an alert when it changes, and run actions from the launcher wheel’s Action Ring
  • Minor fixes and refinements — app volume up to 150%, a Sky Background switch for the weather card, clipboard colour swatches and filters, calendar quick add and countdowns, progress rings that finish with a checkmark, Zoom mute that stays in step, and a steadier lock screen

All release notes

item.title: Version 2.0.2
item.description:
An unread count beside the notch, Back and Forward in Settings, and a Send Feedback window, plus a fix for Notification Center and steadier Bluetooth.

  • Unread badge — a red count beside the closed notch shows notifications you haven't seen; click it to open them
  • Settings — Back and Forward in the toolbar, with ⌘[ and ⌘] or your mouse's side buttons
  • Send Feedback — report a bug or suggest an idea from Settings › About, with screenshots or a screen recording, no email account needed
  • Minor fixes and refinements — the clock opens Notification Center every time with menu bar icons hidden, turning off Connect & Disconnect Alerts stops the nearby AirPods Bluetooth scan, and fixes for launch and lock-screen stability

All release notes

item.title: Version 2.0.1
item.description:
Longer battery life with the desktop pet, a clearer AI Usage chart, Finder-style selection on the Files shelf and a richer lock screen, plus fixes across the app.

  • Easier on your battery — the desktop pet rests while you are away from your Mac and wanders less on battery, and the music bars in the notch use less power
  • AI Usage — a token chart you can read at a glance
  • Files shelf — select files like in Finder: click, ⌘-click, ⇧-click, ⌘A and Esc
  • Minor fixes and refinements — AirPods battery and charging on the lock screen, reminders that show their day, Extra Brightness, Face Unlock, Downloads alerts, Home, Minimal Layout and accessibility

All release notes
